LF-ONTOLOGY-PILOT.name: Independent Ontology Pilot, one site
LF-ONTOLOGY-PILOT.description: Three-month one-site pilot before the annual LF-ONTOLOGY-25 licence, with binary success criteria. It succeeds if at least one of three goals is achieved and accepted by the customer: understanding the business, ownership and responsibilities, or compliance and governance. Each goal has measurable thresholds. Ends in a go / no-go decision. Includes pilot-period usage rights for one named site. 100% of the pilot fee is credited against the first LF-ONTOLOGY-25 licence year when the licence agreement is signed within 90 days of the pilot's end. The annual licence and ongoing support are not included.
features: Unit: one named site, 3 months, one-time, quoted €15,000–€25,000
Credit: 100% of the pilot fee is credited against the first licence year of LF-ONTOLOGY-25 when the licence agreement is signed within 90 days of the pilot's end
Succeeds if at least one of three goals is achieved and accepted by the customer. The pilot tests us, not the customer

Goal A, understanding the business: at least 50 core concepts and 100 relations modelled; at least 3 customer key people review the model; at least 80% of the reviewed concepts and relations assessed as correct

Goal B, ownership and responsibilities: at least 20 key objects or processes mapped; responsible owner identified for at least 90%; for every mapped object, documented whether ownership is clear or unclear, with the unclear ones named; customer accepts the ownership map

Goal C, compliance and governance: at least one regulatory area modelled; at least one chain of responsibility documented end to end; at least one audit or reporting concept map produced; customer accepts the model as a basis for further development
Deliverables: first ontology skeleton, documented concept model, relationship map, ownership map and compliance map where applicable, recommendation
Go / no-go: GO leads to LF-TRAIN-IND and LF-ONTOLOGY-25; HOLD to an extended pilot; NO-GO ends the pilot. All three are acceptable outcomes
Not promised: automatic learning or ready-made decision tracking
Not included: the annual licence and ongoing support
LF-ONTOLOGY-PILOT.priceNote: €15,000–€25,000 one-time, quoted. One named site, 3 months. 100% credited against the first LF-ONTOLOGY-25 licence year if the licence is signed within 90 days of the pilot's end.
LF-ONTOLOGY-PILOT.caption: 3-month pilot before the licence. Fee fully credited to the first licence year within 90 days.
